newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), which has recently filed fraud cases against 32 stocks brokers and companies, is investigating allegations against more brokers and companies.
Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad, now visiting India, met with Indian counterpart I K Gujral in New Delhi and discussed implementation of the treaty on the sharing of the Ganges water.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina told visiting election officials from commonwealth countries that her government does not interfere into the affairs of the Election Commission.
Former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad on Wednesday termed as "rumor" her love affair with his Jatiya Party MP Zinat Hussain.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday held an "open agenda" meeting with leaders of eleven political parties and groups and sought their cooperation in running the country.
The central bank on Wednesay said that no bank had incurred loss due to operation in share market.
The country's export earnings during the last eight months till February stood at $2.86 billion.
